files.targetTimes_N1.json: The first three entries of the live observed-frame index, verbatim apart from the closing bracket
files.hrpns-stripes-4bit.png: Synthetic, no JMA data: a 256 px tile encoded as JMA serves hrpns tiles (4-bit indexed, the same ten-entry PLTE and tRNS read off live tiles that day), with 16 px columns of palette indices 0-9 and index 0 after them
files.hrpns_nd-synthetic.geojson: Synthetic, no JMA data: the shape of hrpns_nd/data.geojson (one NoData polygon whose outer ring is the world and whose hole is the observed area), with the hole reduced to 136-144E, 33-36N

notes: Recorded for the engine's JMA unit tests (engine/src/jma.rs); the daemon never reads them. Live tiles are 256 px Web Mercator PNGs, either 4-bit indexed or 8-bit RGBA; odd zooms are served blank.
